text:
alex: quick design q — prefetch vs live scoring for the rerank endpoint. we're seeing tail latency spikes when we fan out to multiple models. thoughts?

maria: what do you mean by prefetch here? storing intermediate scores at index time?

alex: yeah. run a cheap model at ingest to attach 3-5 candidate priors. on query we can either use those or call the heavy model live. prefetch cuts p99 but can be stale and shifts cost to indexing.

devon: main ops concern: quotas and telemetry. if prefetch counts as rerank calls tenants will hit limits unexpectedly. need separate meters.

jing: +1 on separate meters. console needs to show prefetch vs live usage or support will get flooded.

ryan: also model pinning implication: if a tenant pins to a high-accuracy model, prefetched cheap scores will diverge from pinned model. how do we honor pins?

alex: plan A was: pinned -> always live. unpinned -> try prefetch, then optionally call live for ties/thresholds.

maria: tie-breaking live calls create unpredictable spikes. we should consider a hybrid: prefetched baseline + optional live delta, but throttle live calls and expose backpressure.

devon: telemetry checklist: we need metrics: "prefetch_used", "live_called", "live_latency_p95", "rerank_quality_regression". add a trace tag `score_source`. example: 
```
score_source = "prefetch" | "live" | "hybrid"
```

alex: agreed. billing-wise: treat prefetch as background compute with separate billing line (prefetch_units). console should show background compute under "dedicated / precompute".

ryan: routing policy proposal: fallback order when live model unavailable: pinned model -> model family fallback -> cheapest compatible. console knob to opt-out of fallbacks.

maria: UX: add per-tenant `staleness_threshold` default 24h. prefetch accepted if last_refresh < threshold. expose in console as "prefetch freshness".

devon: quota accounting: increment rerank_quota only on live calls. prefetch increments "prefetch_units". docs and console must make this explicit. otherwise customers will be surprised.

jing: logging nit: include `candidate_count` and `prefetch_version` in logs to debug drift.

ops-bot: deploy-checklist: add feature flag `rerank.prefetch_enabled`. rollout: canary 10% tenants. require `rerank.quality_delta < 0.5%` in canary window for full rollout.

alex: we also need a tiny proto change to the scoring envelope to include `score_source` and `model_version`. draft: 
```
{
  "scores": [0.92, 0.35, ...],
  "score_source": "prefetch",
  "model_version": "hf/opt-350m-quant-v2",
  "prefetch_ts": 1700000000
}
```

maria: keep backwards compatibility: older clients should still accept bare arrays. make new fields optional and console-friendly.

devon: agreed. open an RFC with telemetry dashboard mock, billing rows, and migration notes. i'll own the canary.

alex: i'll write the RFC today and tag @maria @devon @jing for review. thanks :thumbsup:

maria: reading now.

devon: ack.
